conversions.method: Complete UTF-8 stdout; ANSI CSI stripped; hard wrap 112 Unicode code points per line; XML escaped; no omissions, including warnings and final newline.
Derived log view; four literal original lines selected by orderId; visual UTC summary uses internal date fields and CLI sandbox marker; no GUI/desktop source.

clockBound.method: Sum for orders-api and inventory-consumer of maximum over before/slow/collect: max(abs(containerEpochMs-hostBefore),abs(containerEpochMs-hostAfter))+100ms.
clockBound.samplingLimitation: Sampled conservative observation; not a guarantee of clock stability between samples.

validation.method: Post-authoring structural and functional offline checks, not documentation TDD; checker imports only read-only verify.cjs, never runner.cjs.

officialStateBeforeIntegration: 4/10; proposed after integration 5/10 (CP01/04/05/06/07), five pending CP08–12; historical counters preserved.
